# `admin` — `/api/admin`

Running the Grove: its people, their Grove-wide roles and who looks after the website, who may start spaces, who can find Public chat's room, and the activity log. Owners and managers see all of it; only owners change roles and settings.

| Method | Path | Who may call | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/admin/activity`](#get-api-admin-activity) | Grove manager | Newest first. |
| GET | [`/api/admin/people`](#get-api-admin-people) | Grove manager | Everyone with an account: Grove role, host and webmaster, how many spaces, and when last active (Grove owners and managers). |
| PUT | [`/api/admin/people/{uid}/role`](#put-api-admin-people-uid-role) | Grove owner | Makes someone a Grove owner, manager or member (Grove owners). |
| PUT | [`/api/admin/people/{uid}/webmaster`](#put-api-admin-people-uid-webmaster) | Grove owner | Webmasters change the Website folders and publish the Grove's website, as owners do. |
| GET | [`/api/admin/settings`](#get-api-admin-settings) | Grove manager | The Grove-wide settings (Grove owners and managers). |
| PUT | [`/api/admin/settings`](#put-api-admin-settings) | Grove owner | Changes the settings sent; the others stay as they are. |
| GET | [`/api/admin/spaces`](#get-api-admin-spaces) | Grove manager | Every space, whoever started it, and the room its files take. |
| GET | [`/api/admin/wishes`](#get-api-admin-wishes) | Grove manager | What people asked for with the wish lamp, newest first. |

<a id="get-api-admin-activity"></a>
### `GET /api/admin/activity`

Newest first. `person` matches what someone did and what was done to them; pass the returned `next` as `before` for older rows.

- Handler: [`activity`](../../../backend/community/admin.py)
- Who may call: Grove owners and managers

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `before` | query | integer or null | no |  |  |
| `space` | query | string | no | `""` |  |
| `person` | query | string | no | `""` |  |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | `100` | ≥ 1; ≤ 500 |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `items` (JSON list of rows of `activity`: `id`, `at`, `action`, `actor_id`, `actor_name`, `space_id`, `space_name`, `target_id`, `target_name`, `details`), `next`

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | Sign in to continue. | `user` |
| 403 | Only the Grove’s owners and managers can do this. | `grove_manager` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |

<a id="put-api-admin-people-uid-role"></a>
### `PUT /api/admin/people/{uid}/role`

Makes someone a Grove owner, manager or member (Grove owners). The host is always an owner.

- Handler: [`set_role`](../../../backend/community/admin.py)
- Who may call: Grove owners

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `uid` | path | string | yes |  |  |

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `backend__community__admin__RoleBody`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `role` | one of `"owner"`, `"manager"`, `"member"` | yes |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `id`, `role`

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | The host is always an owner. | `set_role` |
| 401 | Sign in to continue. | `user` |
| 403 | Only the Grove’s owners can do this. | `grove_owner` |
| 404 | Person not found. | `set_role` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
